intro:
Project 5 starts with the London page, and the London board cannot be approved until these are
settled (Known Issues 60, 61, 63, 67 and 70 in `docs/reference/session-log.md`). Pick an option
for each; add a note if you want something different. Claude's recommendation is marked.

questions.context: Working rule 16 says no two pages share a hero, but city pages map to the interior-guide family, whose three heroes the guides already use. Recommended: (a) — it scales to 28 pages and keeps rule 16's intent, because each city's own photo and text make its hero unique; the rule-16 gate learns the new family.

options.label: A location hero family: one design, varied per city by rule (its own photo and text)
Exempt the city pages from rule 16 by name, as the utility pages are
A design pass first: a new hero pool for the city pages, rotated so neighbours differ

questions.question: How should the 28 city pages get their heroes?
questions.where: Known Issue 60; `src/lib/boardStyles.ts`; the location builder skill.

questions.context: Today every city page comes from one template, `src/pages/uk-locations/[slug].astro`, fed by `data/locations.json`. Recommended: (a) — one template for 28 pages, and the board freshness check (Known Issue 63) needs only that template added to what it watches.

options.label: Keep the one template; it renders the rebuilt layout when the city's record says so
One `.astro` file per city, like the 12 pages already rebuilt
Content files per city, rendered by one template

questions.question: Where should a rebuilt city page's source live?

questions.context: Today the evidence ledger, the FAQ rows and the boards write L-2-HGA and HC-HSF4; the copy rules write L2-HGA and HC. Recommended: (a) — the Kennel Club's own test names, and the spelling most files already use.
questions.question: Which spelling should every page use for the two DNA tests?
questions.where: Known Issue 67; everything moves to the one you pick.

questions.context: New pages need an image on every heading; where no existing photo fits, one is generated after you approve it on the board. Without the key, project 5 uses existing photos only.

options.label: Yes, I will add it before the London board
Later: use existing photos only for now

questions.question: Will you add your Gemini API key now?
questions.where: `GEMINI_API_KEY` in `.env` (you add it yourself); Known Issue 70.

questions.question: Anything else Claude should know before the London page?

title: Project 5 · decisions before the first city page
